note: In-scope axis for an Odoo 19 addon owning contract/subscription mgmt, price grids, legal invoicing, customer portal, and connection (raccordement) onboarding. Usage metering / Enedis flux / TURPE are delegated to electricore and deliberately EXCLUDED from this rubric.

capabilities.test: generate legal invoices from a contract on a recurring schedule
bill/rebill a past period at the price that was in effect during that period
change price/plan/tariff during the contract lifecycle
prorate partial billing periods (days) on entry/exit/change
cleanly terminate/cancel a contract with final billing
automated reminders / payment retries / collections on unpaid invoices
customer portal to view contracts, invoices, consumption history
customer pays an invoice / manages payment method online in the portal
correct VAT + legally compliant invoice; for FR: Factur-X / e-reporting
issue credit notes / refunds / negative adjustments
onboarding/provisioning pipeline (connection request) driving contract creation
append-only consent journal with timestamp + text version + withdrawal
emit outbound events/webhooks or an integration API for downstream systems
